# Free living-town assets

Reviewed 2026-10-03/04. All imported files are free; no paid editions were used.

| Pack | Source and author | License | Used here |
|---|---|---|---|
| Car Kit 3.1 | [Kenney](https://kenney.nl/assets/car-kit) | CC0 1.0; bundled `CarKit/License.txt` | Sedan, van, delivery van, miniature race kart and wheel meshes; palette texture. Tractor retained as an optional source model. |
| City Kit Suburban 2.0 | [Kenney](https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-suburban) | CC0 1.0; bundled `Suburban/License.txt` | Eleven houses, two trees, and source fence/path/planter parts; palette texture. |

CC0 permits modification and personal, educational and commercial use. Attribution is not required; voluntary credit: **Models by Kenney (kenney.nl)**. The original license files are preserved verbatim. Official pack previews were inspected and saved to `references/AssetPreviews/CarKit.png` and `Suburban.png`.

The crowd reuses the existing [Quaternius Universal Base Characters](https://quaternius.com/packs/universalbasecharacters.html) free rig, with original procedural poses and clothing variations. Its CC0 license is retained at `../Quaternius/LICENSE.txt`. Voluntary credit: **Base characters by Quaternius**. Existing named-customer photo credits remain in `Art/Characters/Likeness/CREDITS.md` and are not replaced by these CC0 credits.

[Quaternius Animated Men](https://quaternius.com/packs/animatedmen.html) and [Ultimate Nature](https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimatenature.html) were evaluated as additional free CC0 options. Animated Men download was quota-blocked; neither pack was imported. Do not list them as shipped assets.

The mower, storefronts, bike assembly, park arrangements, neighborhood props, crowd motion, navigation and gameplay code are original project work. Prefabs in `Art/LivingTown` can be replaced independently of the road graph, orders or activity simulation.

2026-10-05 town revision: no additional third-party assets were downloaded. Six business-front variants, side windows/roof fittings, footpaths, woodland understory, pizza beacon/approach arrows, roof palette shader, and crowd headwear are original project additions. Existing imported packs and their license files are unchanged.
